metadata.workload: synthetic asymmetric photon-ring sky, NOT real EHT/M87/SgrA data
metadata.geometry: 16 noncollinear stations in wavelength/image-FOV units, rigid rotation over pi radians at 64 sparse snapshots across nominal 12h; not geographical EHT stations
metadata.cadence: 64 independent FFT frames per snapshot; sparse synthetic observing windows, not contiguous 12h ADC samples
metadata.sky_to_voltage: C_ab(f,t)=sum_p I_p exp(-2pi i (u_a-u_b)·l_p); S=L z where LL*=C+0.02I, z iid circular complex Gaussian; time voltage=IFFT(S)
metadata.frequency_approximation: narrowband piecewise constant geometry/covariance in each 64-channel group; 16 group center frequencies spanning +/-2%

image_pipeline: observed FX spectra -> average channels within each of 16 narrowband groups -> nearest-grid uv per-cell mean then uniform occupied-cell weighting with conjugate symmetry -> dirty IFFT -> Hogbom CLEAN gain0.1 up to2000 iterations threshold0.005*initialpeak -> Gaussian restore sigma0.7pix + residual; no target ring injected into reconstruction
reconstruction_caveats: No zero-spacing/autocorrelation measurement: dirty map DC is missing and sum near zero. Dirty flux-normalized PSNR undefined.
Restored CLEAN image normalized by its recovered flux for PSNR; 2000 iteration cap reached, not a claim of converged optimal reconstruction.
Gaussian restoration sigma0.7pix is an illustrative beam, not an EHT-derived beam fit.
